subject: Recap: HelioHealth marketplace unit-price bands & PPU targets
messages:
From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rao <aisha@heliohealth.com>, HelioHealth Procurement <procurement@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: HelioHealth marketplace unit-price bands & PPU targets

Hi Aisha / team,

Thanks for taking the time today — quick written recap and proposed next steps so nothing falls through the cracks. Appreciate the candid volume/budget context.

Call summary (short):
- Use case: production inference for HelioHealth’s clinical summarization pipeline + occasional batch rerank for analytics.
- Current estimate: ~120M input+output tokens/month baseline, with potential Q4 spikes up to ~240M/mo.
- Marketplace preference: AWS Marketplace for billing / procurement alignment.
- Target unit economics: aiming ~ $700-$750 / 1M tokens target, flexible with commit/term.

Preliminary PPU bands we discussed (for mapping to a private offer SKU):
- 50–100M tokens/mo: $850 / 1M tokens
- 100–200M tokens/mo: $720 / 1M tokens (target band)
- 200M+ tokens/mo: $640 / 1M tokens (volume tier)

Notes on marketplace mapping / fees:
- Private Offer flow (AWS): Redwood publishes a private-offer listing with SKU that maps to token units; AWS takes its marketplace fee on top of Redwood list price — final bill to HelioHealth is via AWS invoice.
- We typically show list PPU and a reconciliation for marketplace pass-through fees so finance can see net economics.

Immediate next steps (owners):
- Ben: draft initial private-offer SKU-to-PPU mapping and an example billing calc (include marketplace fee line).
- Laura: attach standard wording/PO intake checklist & any compliance artifacts you asked about.
- Aisha / procurement: confirm preferred commitment term (12 vs 24 months) and if you want a Q4 spike buffer. Also upload the attached forecast so we can lock bands.

Attachments: Helio_Monthly_Token_Forecast.xlsx (you shared on the call) — I attached for reference.

If that looks right I’ll schedule a 30-min follow-up with Ben and Laura to walk the mapping.

Thanks,
Connor
Connor Obrien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

--

From: Aisha Rao <aisha@heliohealth.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: HelioHealth Procurement <procurement@heliohealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: HelioHealth marketplace unit-price bands & PPU targets

Thanks Connor — that matches our notes. A few clarifications from procurement’s side: 

1) Volumes: baseline 120M tokens/month as you noted; Q4 plan could push to 220–240M for the three-month window. We can supply a month-by-month expected ramp if that helps with tiering.
2) Budget band: overall target for unit economics is indeed in the $700–$750 / 1M tokens range. We understand higher list price is common and want to see net pricing after marketplace fees.
3) Marketplace: AWS Marketplace is preferred. We need the SKU mapping and a sample invoice calc showing list price, AWS fee, and Redwood net.
4) Commitment: Procurement prefers a 12-month committed volume with an explicit overage mechanism (charge on excess usage at next tier price) — but open to 24 months if the economics improve significantly.

Next: can Ben share a sample private-offer mapping + simple excel calc? If it’s routine to include a 10% Q4 spike buffer in the SKU, that would help avoid constant PO amendments.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—
Aisha Rao
Director, Data Platforms | HelioHealth
aisha@heliohealth.com | +1 (617) 555-2266
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rao <aisha@heliohealth.com>, HelioHealth Procurement <procurement@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Oct 2027 08:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: HelioHealth marketplace unit-price bands & PPU targets

Hi Aisha — looping in what I promised on the call. High-level private-offer mapping and example economics below (will send the detailed PDF + sample invoice as an attachment).

Mapping (short):
- SKU: RDW-HELI-PPU-1M
- Unit = 1M tokens
- Tiers (list price we publish on AWS Marketplace):
  * Tier A (50–100M/mo): $850 / 1M tokens
  * Tier B (100–200M/mo): $720 / 1M tokens
  * Tier C (200M+/mo): $640 / 1M tokens

Example invoice calc (baseline 120M/mo, Tier B):
- List price (published SKU) = $720 * 120 = $86,400 per month
- AWS marketplace fee (example) = 10% = $8,640
- Redwood net = $77,760 / month
- Effective net PPU = $648 / 1M tokens (net after marketplace fee)

Proposal: initial private offer list PPU = $720/1M for 12-month commit at 120M/mo. We can model a Q4 buffer of +20% for the months Oct–Dec to handle spikes (e.g., set commitment 144M for those months or allow auto-billing at Tier C overage).

Attachments: Marketplace_PO_Steps.pdf (walks through AWS PO creation, required legal PO fields, and sample SKU mapping). Also attaching a one-page sample invoice we use for procurement.

If that aligns we’ll:
- Connor: schedule a 30-min mapping call this week to walk procurement and update the HubSpot deal.
- Laura: send PO intake + SOW template for HelioHealth to complete.

Open question: do you want the private-offer to show the net (post-fee) to be invoiced, or should we leave list price visible and show a separate reconciliation sheet? We typically leave list price and provide the reconciliation.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to walk the numbers.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0144

--

Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: HelioHealth marketplace unit-price bands & PPU targets

Ben / Connor — thank you for the clear mapping. Procurement reviewed the example calc and the net PPU looks reasonable. A couple of quick asks before we proceed to PO: 

1) Please share a draft SOW (one page) that ties the committed monthly token volume to a service description and SLAs.
2) A simple PO template with the SKU and term (12 months) so our legal can attach it to the PO quickly.
3) Confirmation in writing that overage will be billed at the next tier price rather than a blended rate.

If we get those three items today, our legal/procurement can produce an internal PO and we’ll route via AWS Marketplace private-offer acceptance. We’ll aim to have an internal sign-off within 48–72 hours.

We’re comfortable proceeding with the 12-month commit at list PPU $720/1M (with reconciliation showing net after marketplace fees). Please send the documents and I’ll confirm the internal PO ID once generated.

Regards,
HelioHealth Procurement
procurement@heliohealth.com
